products.short_description: Design Vault ↔ Purview coexistence for eDiscovery, legal hold, and retention — what's governed where and how holds/retention map across ecosystems — so discovery stays defensible during the transition, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Keep eDiscovery and retention defensible across both ecosystems

During coexistence, legal and compliance must be able to hold, retain, and discover data across both Microsoft Purview and Google Vault — a gap here is a legal risk. This solution designs the Vault ↔ Purview coexistence for eDiscovery, legal hold, and retention: what's governed where, how holds/retention map across ecosystems, and how to run defensible discovery during the transition, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the dual-ecosystem governance model: what data lives in Purview vs Vault during coexistence, and how holds/retention/discovery are coordinated.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Vault-capable Workspace edition, Purview access, legal/eDiscovery stakeholders, retention policy, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure Google Vault retention/holds, map to Purview during coexistence, define the discovery workflow across both, validate on a pilot, then expand.
  • 5 supporting scripts — retention/hold discovery across the estate, per-scope retention/hold validation, a coverage/gap report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (holds effective, retention applied, discovery returns) plus Best Practices for defensible eDiscovery.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Defensible eDiscovery, legal hold, and retention across both Google Vault and Microsoft Purview — no compliance gaps during coexistence — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWVAULT-Discovery.ps1 — retention/hold discovery across the Vault + Purview estate (read-only)
    • GWVAULT-Remediation.ps1 — close a Vault-side coexistence hold gap by adding a hold (default -WhatIf)
    • GWVAULT-Report.ps1 — coverage/gap report for Vault <-> Purview coexistence holds (read-only)
    • GWVAULT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the coexistence pilot custodian scope + matter (idempotent, default -WhatIf)
    • GWVAULT-Validation.ps1 — per-scope retention/hold validation for a coexistence matter (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
